room.description: An original quiet band practice room, a small table, chairs, one entrance, soft afternoon light. Use the supplied scene image as the layout and lighting reference.

shots.visual_description: A fixed medium two-shot in the reference practice room. @anon stands on the left beside a table and carefully lifts a folded note. @tomori stands on the right, initially looking down at it. Show their faces and hands without cropping either head. @anon turns the note slightly toward @tomori, asks her question, then closes her mouth and waits. @tomori looks up before replying quietly. Keep the note unprinted at this distance; no readable text is needed. Finish with both characters looking toward the room entrance. The camera remains on the same side of the table.

dialogue.text: このメモ、誰が置いたの？
待ってるって、書いてある。
dialogue.delivery: Quiet and slightly hesitant, with a short pause.

shots.ambience: Quiet indoor room tone, gentle clothing movement and small object sounds. Keep dialogue clear. No audience-only background music.

shots.visual_description: A medium two-shot from inside the same practice room facing its entrance. @taki stands near the doorway on the right and glances at a simple wall clock without a readable close-up. @soyo waits on the left with one hand on a chair back. @taki lowers her gaze and speaks to @soyo rather than to the camera. @soyo answers with a small reassuring smile. Let the pauses read through their eyes and shoulders. Neither character crosses behind the other. Finish on a shared glance toward the table established in the previous segment.

dialogue.text: まだ一人、来てないみたい。

shots.ambience: Quiet indoor room tone, gentle clothing movement and small object sounds. Keep dialogue clear. No audience-only background music.

shots.visual_description: A steady medium shot of the table and a nearby chair. @rana steps into the left side of frame and stops beside the folded note. @tomori is already at the right side of the table. @rana lightly points toward the note while making her short statement, then lets her arm rest naturally. @tomori looks from the note to @rana and answers with a tentative smile. Show one clear pointing gesture rather than repeated hand movement. Retain the established outfit and room lighting. End with @rana meeting @tomori’s gaze; do not introduce another character.

dialogue.text: 一緒に、音を出したかったの？
dialogue.delivery: Soft surprise that turns into warmth.

shots.ambience: Quiet indoor room tone, gentle clothing movement and small object sounds. Keep dialogue clear. No audience-only background music.

shots.visual_description: A medium two-shot in the practice room with the table at frame edge. @anon stands on the left and relaxes her shoulders as the misunderstanding resolves. @soyo stands on the right facing her at a slight angle. @anon gives a brief apologetic smile while speaking. @soyo answers, then draws an empty chair a small distance away from the table with one controlled movement. Keep the chair legs and hands stable. Finish with both turning their attention toward the rehearsal area, without a camera reversal or a sudden background change.

dialogue.text: じゃあ、待たせちゃったね。
今からでも、間に合うよ。

shots.ambience: Quiet indoor room tone, gentle clothing movement and small object sounds. Keep dialogue clear. No audience-only background music.

shots.visual_description: A medium shot in the same room, with @taki on the left and @rana on the right. Both face inward toward the empty rehearsal space rather than the viewer. @taki raises one hand slightly to suggest a starting cue, speaks, and lowers it before @rana replies. @rana gives a small nod. Keep this a preparation moment; do not show complex instrument playing or add singing. The camera makes at most a gentle, short forward movement. End with both characters ready and still, leaving a clear edit point into the group shot.

dialogue.text: 最初の一音、合わせよう。

shots.ambience: Quiet indoor room tone, gentle clothing movement and small object sounds. Keep dialogue clear. No audience-only background music.

shots.visual_description: A wide, static group shot in the familiar practice room. @tomori stands nearest the center, @anon at the left foreground, @rana slightly behind the center, @soyo at the right foreground and @taki beside her. Keep all five faces distinct and the previously established outfits unchanged. Only @tomori speaks; the others listen with closed mouths and restrained smiles. After the line, hold the shared moment for a short beat while @anon gives one small nod. No coordinated instrument performance, overlapping dialogue, titles, new scene or extra person. Finish in a stable composition.
